Start.title: Start a session on Android and launch an app
Start on an iOS simulator and see what you got
Start.code:
dev, err := mobium.Start(ctx, mobium.WithPlatform("ios"))
if err != nil {
	return err
}
defer dev.Quit(ctx)
s := dev.Session()
fmt.Println(s.Device, s.Platform, s.Driver, s.Reused)
